title: The Lunchbox
favouriteScene: The quiet moments Saajan Fernandes spends smelling the letter on his balcony amidst the Mumbai evening sounds.
favouritePerformance: Irrfan Khan as Saajan Fernandes & Nawazuddin Siddiqui as Shaikh
personalReflections: A film that breathes through its pauses. Demonstrates that loneliness in a city of millions can be bridged by something as simple as handwriting, shared food, and shared doubt.
